endorsements.quote: Ensure adequate staff training and education around CIT tools.

unlisted_practices: Make content-importing technology use easily identifiable by clearly marking copied or imported data in the user interface with provenance (original author, date, source).
Require validation or attestation by the author of data and text generated using content-importing technology, and limit automatic transfer or generation of data without author review.
Add confirmation steps for importing outdated or otherwise questionable data into clinical notes.
Regularly monitor and audit content-importing technology usage and documentation practices to detect risky practices and outliers.
Conduct regular user-centered design evaluations before and after implementation of EHR documentation tools.
Clinicians should use copy-paste, macros and dotphrases sparingly and avoid propagating outdated information.
Clinicians should provide feedback on EHR usability and documentation problems to leadership, IT staff, and EHR developers.
Use documentation audits and stakeholder feedback, ideally automated, for continuous optimization of documentation practices.
Engage clinicians, coders, EHR vendors, and clinical leaders together in developing documentation strategy.
